mapper.insert: insert into `note_index` (`owner_id`,`note_name`,`title`,`category`,`tags`,`source_key`, `is_public`,`content_indexed`,`content`,`preview`,`owner_name`,`update_time`) values (#{ownerId},#{noteName},#{title},#{category},#{tags},#{sourceKey}, #{isPublic},#{contentIndexed},#{content},#{preview},#{ownerName}, date_format(now(),'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s')) on duplicate key update `title`=values(`title`), `category`=values(`category`), `tags`=values(`tags`), `source_key`=values(`source_key`), `is_public`=values(`is_public`), `content_indexed`=values(`content_indexed`), `content`=values(`content`), `preview`=values(`preview`), `owner_name`=values(`owner_name`), `update_time`=values(`update_time`)
mapper.select: select `owner_id`,`note_name`,`title`,`category`,`tags`,`source_key`, `is_public`,`content_indexed`,`preview`,`owner_name`, date_format(`update_time`,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') as `update_time` from `note_index` where `source_key`=#{sourceKey} and `is_public`=1 order by `update_time` desc, `id` desc limit #{limit}
select `category` as `name`, count(*) as `cnt` from `note_index` where `owner_id`=#{ownerId} and `category`<>'' group by `category` order by cnt desc, `category` asc
select `tags` as `name`, count(*) as `cnt` from `note_index` where `owner_id`=#{ownerId} and `tags`<>'' group by `tags`
select count(1) from `note_index` where (`is_public`=1 or `owner_id`=#{currentUserId}) and `owner_id`=#{currentUserId} and `content_indexed`=1 and `content` like concat('%',#{keyword},'%')
select count(1) from `note_index` where `is_public`=1 and `content_indexed`=1 and ifnull(`content`,'')<>''
